# Harvard Gazette

> > Official news outlet of Harvard University, delivering stories about research, campus life, and global impact from Cambridge, MA.

The Harvard Gazette is managed by Harvard Public Affairs and Communications and serves as the primary source for news about Harvard's academic community, groundbreaking research, and institutional developments. Access to certain content and management features requires HarvardKey authentication.

## Key Topics

- Harvard University
- Harvard Gazette
- Harvard Public Affairs and Communications
- HarvardKey authentication
- Campus news and community
- Research and discovery
- Nation and world coverage
- Academic programs
- Student life
- Faculty achievements

- Cambridge, MA
- Official university publication
- Higher education news
- University communications

## About & Core Information

- [About — Harvard Gazette](https://test.news.harvard.edu/gazette/about-harvard-gazette/): About Harvard Gazette, official news outlet for Harvard University

## Authentication & Access

- [HarvardKey Sign In - Content Management](https://content.news.harvard.edu/): HarvardKey sign-in portal for content management system access
- [HarvardKey Sign In - NewsPlus](https://content.news.harvard.edu/gazette/story/newsplus/): HarvardKey authentication login page for accessing Gazette content

## News Sections

- [Nation & World](https://content.news.harvard.edu/gazette/section/nation-world/): HarvardKey login required to access Nation & World news section
- [Campus & Community](https://content.news.harvard.edu/gazette/section/campus-community/): HarvardKey authentication for Campus & Community section access
